title: Honor tables/exclude_tables in the Database tool and fix its schema SQL

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1069] Honor `tables:` and `exclude_tables:` in `Langchain::Tool::Database#list_tables` and `#dump_schema`, list the key columns of a composite primary key, and drop the trailing comma from the schema of a table without a primary key.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1071] Use the loader's `chunker:` for every file of a directory loaded with `Langchain::Loader`, and match file extensions case-insensitively, so `NOTES.TXT` no longer raises `UnknownFormatError`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1070] Return a message instead of raising from `Langchain::Tool::FileSystem` (reading a directory, listing a file, writing into a missing directory) and `Langchain::Tool::Calculator` (division by zero), and from `Langchain::Tool::Weather` when the weather request fails after the location lookup, which ended the `Langchain::Assistant` run in `:failed`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1066] Read the fixed output with `#chat_completion` in `Langchain::OutputParsers::OutputFixingParser`; `#completion` is `nil` or not implemented on the Anthropic, Ollama, Mistral AI and Google Gemini chat responses, so fixing never succeeded there.

@@ -78,7 +77,7 @@ def describe_tables(tables: [])

@@ -100,38 +99,35 @@ def execute(input:)
 
     private
 
+    # The tables the tool works with: the requested ones (all if none were given) minus the excluded ones
+    #
+    # @return [Array<Symbol>] The table names
+    def tables
+      names = db.tables
+      names &= requested_tables.map(&:to_sym) if requested_tables.any?
+      names - excluded_tables.map(&:to_sym)
+    end
+
     # Describes a table and its schema
     #
     # @param table [String] The table to describe
     # @return [Langchain::Tool::Response] The schema for the table
     def describe_table(table)
-      # TODO: There's probably a clear way to do all of this below
-
-      primary_key_columns = []
-      primary_key_column_count = db.schema(table).count { |column| column[1][:primary_key] == true }
-
-      schema = "CREATE TABLE #{table}(\n"
-      db.schema(table).each do |column|
-        schema << "#{column[0]} #{column[1][:type]}"
-        if column[1][:primary_key] == true
-          schema << " PRIMARY KEY" if primary_key_column_count == 1
-        else
-          primary_key_columns << column[0]
-        end
-        schema << " COMMENT '#{column[1][:comment]}'" if column[1][:comment]
-        schema << ",\n" unless column == db.schema(table).last && primary_key_column_count == 1
-      end
-      if primary_key_column_count > 1
-        schema << "PRIMARY KEY (#{primary_key_columns.join(",")})"
+      columns = db.schema(table)
+      primary_keys = columns.select { |_name, info| info[:primary_key] == true }.map(&:first)
+
+      definitions = columns.map do |name, info|
+        definition = "#{name} #{info[:type]}"
+        definition << " PRIMARY KEY" if primary_keys == [name]
+        definition << " COMMENT '#{info[:comment]}'" if info[:comment]
+        definition
       end
+      definitions << "PRIMARY KEY (#{primary_keys.join(",")})" if primary_keys.size > 1
       db.foreign_key_list(table).each do |fk|
-        schema << ",\n" if fk == db.foreign_key_list(table).first
-        schema << "FOREIGN KEY (#{fk[:columns]&.first}) REFERENCES #{fk[:table]}(#{fk[:key]&.first})"
-        schema << ",\n" unless fk == db.foreign_key_list(table).last
+        definitions << "FOREIGN KEY (#{fk[:columns]&.first}) REFERENCES #{fk[:table]}(#{fk[:key]&.first})"
       end
-      schema << ");\n"
 
-      tool_response(content: schema)
+      tool_response(content: "CREATE TABLE #{table}(\n#{definitions.join(",\n")});\n")
     end
   end
 end

@@ -56,4 +56,50 @@
       expect(response.content).to eq("CREATE TABLE users(\nid integer PRIMARY KEY,\nname string,\njob string,\nFOREIGN KEY (job) REFERENCES jobs());\n")
     end
   end
+
+  context "with a real SQLite database" do
+    subject { described_class.new(connection_string: "sqlite:/", tables: [:users, :memberships, :logs], exclude_tables: [:logs]) }
+
+    before do
+      subject.db.create_table(:users) do
+        primary_key :id
+        String :name
+      end
+      subject.db.create_table(:memberships) do
+        Integer :user_id
+        Integer :group_id
+        String :role
+        primary_key [:user_id, :group_id]
+      end
+      subject.db.create_table(:logs) { String :line }
+      subject.db.create_table(:audits) { String :line }
+    end
+
+    it "lists only the requested tables, minus the excluded ones" do
+      expect(subject.list_tables.content).to contain_exactly(:users, :memberships)
+    end
+
+    it "dumps the schema of those tables only" do
+      expect(subject.dump_schema.content).to include("CREATE TABLE users(").and include("CREATE TABLE memberships(")
+      expect(subject.dump_schema.content).not_to include("logs")
+      expect(subject.dump_schema.content).not_to include("audits")
+    end
+
+    it "lists every table but the excluded ones when no tables are requested" do
+      tool = described_class.new(connection_string: "sqlite:/", exclude_tables: [:logs])
+      allow(tool).to receive(:db).and_return(subject.db)
+
+      expect(tool.list_tables.content).to contain_exactly(:users, :memberships, :audits)
+    end
+
+    it "names the primary key columns of a composite key" do
+      expect(subject.describe_tables(tables: [:memberships]).content).to eq(
+        "CREATE TABLE memberships(\nuser_id integer,\ngroup_id integer,\nrole string,\nPRIMARY KEY (user_id,group_id));\n"
+      )
+    end
+
+    it "leaves no trailing comma for a table without a primary key" do
+      expect(subject.describe_tables(tables: [:logs]).content).to eq("CREATE TABLE logs(\nline string);\n")
+    end
+  end
 end
